name: deepseek-harness-local
description: Connect ChatGPT to a local DeepSeek Harness coding-agent runtime.

interface.longDescription: Run software engineering tasks through your own DeepSeek Harness runtime. The agent executes on your Windows PC inside its configured workspace and sandbox. Pending risky operations require explicit one-time approval.
defaultPrompt: Use my local DeepSeek Harness to inspect this repository and propose a verified implementation plan.
Use my local DeepSeek Harness to implement a software change, run tests, and report the exact verification results.
Check my local DeepSeek Harness sessions and any pending approvals.
